description: Calibration evidence attached to every audio diagnostic row. Figures are case counts from docs/AUDIO_CALIBRATION_2026-10-20.md, docs/FALSE_MATCH_BENCHMARK_2026-10-21.md and docs/PROJECT_ROCK_FINDINGS_2026-10-22.md, each with a 95% Wilson interval, not probabilities. The frozen gate profile (audio_calibration_profile.json) is unchanged. false_match_rates are filled by benchmarks/false_match.py.

splits.development: Cases used to choose or revise the frozen gates.
splits.held_out: Cases evaluated only after the gates were frozen; never used for tuning.
splits.real_material: Production material never used for tuning, with ground truth from production documents.

intervals.note: An interval describes the uncertainty of one small count, not a population rate. Cases derived from one source family or one session are not independent, so the real uncertainty is wider.

audfprint.summary: Excerpt and mixture-component offsets (error <= 0.1 s): development 26/28 found at density 40; held-out 15/16 found; 0/6 controls supported. Lumina false-match benchmark (2026-10-21): 0/5 same-genre and 0/4 same-prompt pairs matched; a shared drum loop was detected in 1/4 pairs at loop gain 0.5 and 4/4 at gain 1.0, at the correct offset.

development.measure: Mixture components and excerpts found at the correct offset (error <= 0.1 s, density 40)
Distinct-recording controls with a supported offset

held_out.measure: Mixture components and excerpts found at the correct offset (error <= 0.1 s, density 40), original four held-out Lumina families
Distinct-recording controls with a supported offset

real_material.measure: Project Rock Ep01 AAF-used takes with a supported match, whole-take comparison
Project Rock Ep01 AAF-range tasks with a supported match inside the used range
real_material.note: One task (6T03) had a candidate below the support gates; 14 tasks cover 13 takes.

false_match_rates.definition: a candidate offset whose support_assessment is supported_within_profile

shared_loop.note: The loop is real shared audio; a fingerprint match does not mean one song derives from the other.

shared_loop_full_gain.note: The loop is real shared audio; a fingerprint match does not mean one song derives from the other.

false_match_rates.scope: Case counts on a small Lumina sample; not a population false-positive rate.

music_semantics.summary: Known DSP derivatives: development 7 Lumina families, 63 cases (59 supported, 4 abstained, transposition correct in 59/59, max tempo error 1.76%); validation 8 SALAMI families, 72 cases (57 supported, 15 abstained, 57/57 correct, max tempo error 1.27%). Controls: 0/22 and 0/29 supported. Sections: 16 SALAMI recordings, held-out boundary F@3s 0.538. Lumina false-match benchmark (2026-10-21): 0/5 same-genre, 0/4 same-prompt and 0/8 shared-loop pairs supported. Requested covers could not be verified as covers, so covers remain untested.
